title: fix(plugin-dashboard): leave a tile out when the server refuses its data to the viewer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8FDqjYqfv8yYJMJVHqWEn2v)_
Refs #26971 (item 1: a viewer who cannot read a tile's data does not see a permission-error tile)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:仪表盘在非设计模式下,服务器以读权限拒绝(403 / PERMISSION_DENIED)某个数据集磁贴的查询后,该磁贴连同卡片框和标题整个不再渲染,其余磁贴自动重排。
- 为什么改:HotCRM 销售业绩仪表盘里,无权读取某数据集的用户会看到一块「无权查看」的错误磁贴,应用无法只对该用户隐藏它(#26971 验收项 1)。
- 风险与回滚:仅渲染层;403 仍是唯一判据,不做客户端猜测。设计模式与可编辑网格仍显示「无权访问」状态。回滚即还原 DashboardRenderer.tsx 的两处改动。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`(refusedTiles 状态与 renderWidget 中的 return null)、`DatasetWidget.tsx`(onForbidden 回调)、新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.refusedTile-26971.test.tsx`,预期 3 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `DatasetWidget` takes an optional `onForbidden` callback and calls it when its query is refused as a read refusal (`classifyLoadError(e) === 'forbidden'`). It still draws the objectui#10899 no-access state itself, so any host that keeps the tile on screen is unchanged. `DatasetWidget` is not exported from the package entry.
- `DashboardRenderer` records each refused tile (keyed by the tile key and the dataset it names) and, outside design mode, renders nothing for it: no Card frame, no title. The desktop layout is span-flow (array order is visual order) and the mobile layout is two stacks, so the remaining tiles reflow with no gap.
- In design mode the tile stays, selectable, with the no-access state. `DashboardGridLayout` (react-grid-layout, explicit x/y) is not changed and keeps the no-access state; the console's `DashboardView` renders `DashboardRenderer`.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` patch.

## Why

A viewer holding only some permission sets saw one dashboard tile answer "You don't have permission to view the data behind this widget" among tiles that answered, and the app had no key to hide that one tile. Triage routed the card to target 2 (a read-aware default, no new widget key); the seat chose "leave the tile out" because the quiet cell already exists since objectui#10899.

## Tests

New `__tests__/DashboardRenderer.refusedTile-26971.test.tsx`, two table tiles, one whose dataset query rejects with the refusal shape (`httpStatus: 403`, `code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED'`):

1. View mode: the readable tile renders; the refused tile was queried, and afterwards neither its title nor any no-access text is in the document.
2. CONTROL, design mode: the refused tile stays (`dashboard-preview-widget-quota_attainment`) and shows the no-access state.
3. CONTROL: a non-refusal failure (400) keeps the tile, its title and its error text.

`DatasetWidget.forbiddenState-10899.test.tsx` stays green (it pins the widget-level state, which stays).

<details><summary>Ablation (head 52ed2839)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the line that returns null for a refused tile outside design mode (anchor hit once, blob changed). The view-mode case went red ("drops the refused tile, frame and title included, and keeps the readable one"), both controls stayed green (1 failed / 2 passed). The tool restored the file: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the renderer by relative path, so no dist leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing is hidden before the server answers: the tile shows its normal loading skeleton, then leaves. A refused tile is not re-queried until the dashboard remounts, so a permission granted mid-session shows after a reload.
- If every tile of a dashboard is refused, the viewer sees the header and an empty grid; no message is drawn for that case.
- Object-bound inline widgets (an `object` key, no `dataset`) are not pre-filtered by the viewer's read permission in this PR (the dispatch's optional `DashboardView` pre-filter was not built).
- Acceptance item 2 (the spec describes the behaviour) is outside this PR: it needs a sentence in `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` beside `requiresObject`, which the seat files as a spec-lane card.
